items.statement: The supplied AB, BA and AC structures are relaxed with disclosed convergence and object identities retained.
items.expected: A reproducible relaxation record exists for all three named structures, including convergence evidence.

items.statement: A-type AFM is tested against a competing magnetic arrangement and the comparison is reported per named structure.
items.expected: The submission documents an explicit magnetic comparison for AB and AC and retains its energies/moments.

items.statement: The AB-to-BA path is finite, continuous, identity-preserving and validated with AC tested as an intermediate.
items.expected: Path images/states, interpolation or generation rule, and maximum-energy state are reported.

items.statement: The AB-to-BA switching barrier is approximately 15.4 meV per unit cell.
AB and BA have opposite out-of-plane polarization, with AB magnitude approximately 0.087 pC/m.
AB and BA have opposite net ferrimagnetic moments of magnitude approximately 0.19 μB per cell, while AC is compensated.
